newsitem.title: USA: Lifeway Foods sees 1997 EPS above $0.20.
newsitem.headline: Lifeway Foods sees 1997 EPS above $0.20.

text.p: Lifeway Foods said Wednesday it expects to exceed the $0.20 EPS analysts' view for 1997.

"We are confident that we can exceed $0.20 per share earnings analysts have estimated for 1997 as demand for our products continues to grow and we add capacity with our new 46,000 square foot plant," said Michael Smolyansky, president and chief executive officer, in an earnings statement.
"We continue to see strong revenue and earning growth," Smolyansky added.
Lifeway also said it expected to start operations later this month at the new plant, which it said has potential capacity to increase company production up to 20 times.
Earlier Wednesday, Lifeway reported second-quarter earnings of $0.07 a share versus $0.05 during the same 1996 period.
Lifeway is a supplier of a fermented beverage called kefir and also markets cheese, seasoning and drinkable yogurt.
